name: Provnance
tagline: Verified provenance for the secondary luxury market, at institutional scale.
positioning: Provnance gives resale platforms and auction houses a defensible authentication trail for every handbag, watch, and jewel that passes through their inventory.

hero.h1: Every luxury item deserves a record it can't outrun.
hero.sub: Provnance builds an evidence-grade authentication trail for resale platforms, auction houses, and consignment desks — so provenance follows the item, not the paperwork.

features.title: Serial and hardware capture
features.description: Guided photo and microscopy workflows record date codes, stamps, and hardware wear so authenticators review the same evidence set every time.

features.title: Chain-of-custody ledger
features.description: Every intake, transfer, and grading decision is timestamped and attributed, giving your compliance team a defensible history per SKU.

features.title: Expert review routing
features.description: Route ambiguous pieces to the right specialist — watches, leather goods, fine jewelry — with full case context attached.

features.title: Counterfeit signal alerts
features.description: Flag recurring fakes by reference number, seller, or hardware batch before they reach a listing or a buyer.

features.title: Certificate issuance
features.description: Generate branded authentication certificates and transferable digital records that carry with the item on resale.

features.title: Audit-ready exports
features.description: Export full case files for insurers, marketplaces, and regulators in one signed package — no screenshot archaeology.

testimonials.quote: We stopped losing a full day per contested handbag. Provnance keeps the serial imagery, the grader's notes, and the transfer log in one file our legal team actually trusts.
testimonials.name: Camille Roux

testimonials.quote: The chain-of-custody ledger settled a six-figure dispute in an afternoon. Every touchpoint was already documented and attributed.
testimonials.name: Daniel Osei

testimonials.quote: Usage-based pricing meant we onboarded three consignment desks without renegotiating a contract. We pay for the pieces we actually verify.
testimonials.name: Helena Brandt

For resale marketplaces scaling volume across categories.

homepage.footerBlurb: Provnance is the authentication system of record for the secondary luxury market. Provenance that follows the item.
